corrections.quote: Featuring a 1 km wide frontage and 876 shops in a strip mall-inspired layout

unresolved.note: IMPORTANT: our number GGM/605/337/2022/80 is NOT Capital Walk. On HARERA (searchprojectDetail/2053) it is 'M3M Route65', Village Maidawas, Sector-65, promoter Manglam Multiplex Pvt Ltd, 'GGM/605/337/2022/80 DATED 31.08.2022 (SUPERSEDED BY GGM/803/535/2024/30 DATED 27.03.2024)'. The builder's Capital Walk page (m3mindia.com/retail/m3m-capital-walk) prints no RERA number. Portals cite GGM/612/344/2022/87, but the builder's own M3M Capital page assigns that number to the residential 'M3M Capital' Phase 2 (Union Buildmart; also 531/263/2022/06 Phase 1 and 825/557/2024/52 Phase 3). Capital Walk's own registration could not be established from a builder source; recommend removing the Route65 number.

Builder page gives no possession date, and because the project's registration could not be identified, no REP-I completion date can be attributed. (For reference only: M3M Capital Phase 2 REP-I, GGM/612/344/2022/87, shows likely completion 31-12-2026 and 2.98 acres under commercial units out of 7.71 acres, but the builder does not link it to Capital Walk.)
Builder page publishes no price (enquiry form only).
Builder lists retail and F&B, double-height showrooms, 876 shops; no unit sizes published.
Builder page states no land area; 18.95 acres unconfirmed. The 7.71-acre figure some sites quote matches the M3M Capital Phase 2 RERA filing, not a Capital Walk filing.
